ONE AUDIT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT: errors-in-console. Lighthouse counts a
failed network request as a console error, and the Next.js App Router
prefetches every <Link> in view then aborts those requests on teardown -
24 ERR_ABORTED on ?_rsc= URLs per run. Measured against a production build
on 2026-08-07: 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 responses >= 400, and 0
failed requests that were not an RSC prefetch. The audit cannot tell the
framework's behaviour from an application defect, so the precise check
lives in e2e/evidence.spec.ts instead, which filters to real console
errors and pageerrors and asserts zero. Do not re-add this audit here
without also removing the reason it fires.
